movie.title: Number One
movie.overview: Eighteen-year-old Ha-min suddenly begins to see the number "365" every time he eats his mother's homemade meal—and the number drops with each bite. Believing it to be a countdown to his mother's death, he distances himself from her and her cooking. Years later, still haunted by the number, Ha-min lives cautiously, preparing for the worst. Just as he begins to find peace with his girlfriend Ryeo-eun, an unexpected truth turns his world upside down.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Ha-min sees a mysterious, decreasing number every time he eats his mother's cooking, driving him to distance himself from her in a desperate attempt to delay a countdown he believes leads to her death.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: At eighteen years old, Ha-min notices the number '365' appearing whenever he eats meals cooked by his mother, with the digit decreasing with every bite. Convinced that reaching zero will trigger her untimely death, he makes the painful choice to avoid her food and isolate himself from her. Years later, while trying to build a normal life and finding solace in a new relationship, Ha-min is forced to confront the haunting mystery of the countdown. Ultimately, a shocking revelation shatters his long-held assumptions about the numbers and his mother's fate.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Ha-min's ordinary life takes a surreal turn at age eighteen when he witnesses the number '365' floating in front of him while eating his mother's home-cooked food. Terrified after noticing that the number decreases steadily with every single bite he takes, he concludes that it represents a ticking clock counting down to her demise. To protect her, he abruptly stops eating her meals and creates an emotional distance between them, leaving his mother confused and heartbroken. Years pass as Ha-min lives a guarded, anxious existence, constantly paralyzed by the fear of losing her. He eventually meets Ryeo-eun, a supportive girlfriend who brings warmth and stability back into his quiet world. Just as he begins to let his guard down and imagine a peaceful future, the supernatural phenomenon resurfaces in an unexpected way. Confronting the mystery once again, Ha-min uncovers a hidden truth behind the countdown that completely upends everything he thought he knew about his mother's love and sacrifice. Forced to re-evaluate years of missed moments, Ha-min must come to terms with the reality of the numbers before time truly runs out.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Eighteen-year-old Ha-min leads a quiet life until a strange phenomenon changes everything: every time he eats a meal prepared by his mother, the number '365' appears and ticks downward with each bite. Driven by the agonizing belief that the number signifies a countdown to his mother's death, Ha-min makes the heartbreaking decision to stop eating her food and push her away. Years later, still burdened by the fear and guilt of his past, he attempts to build a life with his girlfriend Ryeo-eun. However, the mystery of the declining digits refuses to leave him, leading to an unexpected revelation that reshapes his understanding of life, family, and fate.

story_structure.climax: Just as Ha-min begins to settle into a sense of normalcy, an unexpected truth regarding the actual meaning of the countdown and his mother's meals is revealed, completely shattering his long-held assumptions.
story_structure.conflict: Believing the number represents an inescapable countdown to his mother's imminent death, Ha-min makes the painful choice to distance himself from her and refuse her home-cooked food in a desperate attempt to pause or avoid the timer.
story_structure.resolution: Ha-min must confront the emotional reality of the revealed truth, re-evaluate his years of self-imposed isolation, and come to terms with his past choices and his relationship with his mother.
story_structure.introduction: Eighteen-year-old Ha-min leads a typical life until he suddenly begins seeing the mysterious number '365' floating above his mother's homemade meals, with the digit dropping with every single bite he takes.
story_structure.risingAction: Years pass as Ha-min carries the heavy burden of the mysterious phenomenon, living cautiously and preparing for the worst while keeping his distance, eventually trying to find stability and emotional peace through a new relationship with his girlfriend, Ryeo-eun.
